svg.aria-label: The OCR ladder: the PDF text layer first, then PaddleOCR, then Tesseract with per-language packs, then a vision model when AI is on. A page still below the confidence bar goes to Needs review.
svg.title: The OCR ladder: the PDF text layer first, then PaddleOCR, then Tesseract with per-language packs, then a vision model when AI is on. A page still below the confidence bar goes to Needs review.

g.text: Each page climbs only as far as it needs to.
Still below the confidence bar, it goes to a person.
